description: Utility functions for managing OpenThread IPv6 addresses and multicast addresses within Zephyr network interface, including adding/removing addresses and checking address types.

methods.name: is_anycast_locator
methods.description: Checks if an address is an anycast locator based on specific address fields.

methods.name: is_mesh_local
methods.description: Determines if an address has a mesh local prefix.

methods.name: pkt_list_add
methods.description: Adds a packet to the OpenThread packet list, handling full list conditions.

methods.name: pkt_list_remove_first
methods.description: Removes the first packet from the packet list.

methods.name: pkt_list_peek
methods.description: Returns the first packet in the list without removing it.

methods.name: pkt_list_remove_last
methods.description: Removes the last packet from the packet list.

methods.name: add_ipv6_addr_to_zephyr
methods.description: Adds IPv6 unicast addresses from OpenThread to Zephyr network interface.

methods.name: add_ipv6_addr_to_ot
methods.description: Adds a specified IPv6 address from Zephyr to OpenThread.

methods.name: add_ipv6_maddr_to_ot
methods.description: Subscribes OpenThread to a multicast IPv6 address.

methods.name: add_ipv6_maddr_to_zephyr
methods.description: Adds multicast IPv6 addresses from OpenThread to Zephyr network interface.

methods.name: rm_ipv6_addr_from_zephyr
methods.description: Removes IPv6 addresses from Zephyr network interface that are no longer present in OpenThread.

methods.name: rm_ipv6_maddr_from_zephyr
methods.description: Removes multicast IPv6 addresses from Zephyr network interface that are no longer present in OpenThread.
